title: NEB Class 11 Biology — Introductory Microbiology — 2023
subject: biology
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: What are the characteristic features of bacteria? Give one example each of beneficial and harmful bacteria.
questions.solution:
**Bacteria (Kingdom Monera):** Prokaryotic, unicellular, no nucleus, cell wall present (peptidoglycan), reproduce by binary fission.

- Beneficial: *Rhizobium* (nitrogen fixation), *Lactobacillus* (yogurt production)
- Harmful: *Mycobacterium tuberculosis* (TB), *Salmonella typhi* (typhoid)
questions.knowledgeNote: Bacteria are classified by shape: cocci (spherical), bacilli (rod-shaped), spirilla (spiral).
